mentions.name: Companion Android App
mentions.description: Android companion app that offloads the heavy processing for the Untether Garmin watch apps, handling phone-microphone dictation, on-device AI inference, and Android notification relaying with no internet access. Part of an offline, privacy-first ecosystem; currently in beta.
mentions.audience: Garmin smartwatch users who want to reduce phone screentime while keeping essential functionality
mentions.author: msyea
